accessible_article_evidence: The accessible Methods cover leaf RNA-seq for phylogeny, genome size, EBSP, SDM and morphology; searches for anthocyanin/expression return only the abstract and conclusion statements.
supplement_recovery_status: Recovered official Supplementary Material 1 from the alternate Springer static host; 13 figures and 6 tables contain genome-size, coalescent, SDM, morphology, sample/voucher and specimen evidence, with zero occurrences of anthocyanin or expression.
EAzami_interpretation: Do not treat this paper as having experimentally established the molecular mechanism of white/bluish-purple polymorphism. A separately citable primary experiment may exist, but none is identified in the article or recovered supplement.

accessible_article_evidence: The accessible Methods and Results contain no pollinator observation, preference experiment or pollinator-response analysis; searches for pollinator return only the abstract and conclusion statements.
supplement_recovery_status: Recovered official Supplementary Material 1; zero occurrences of pollinator or preference and no pollinator data table/figure.
EAzami_interpretation: Pollinator preference remains an open Chapter 2/3 test and does not currently remove EAzami novelty.

accessible_article_evidence: White and bluish-purple var. takaoense morphs were compared morphologically; the paper reports no structural divergence beyond slight size variation and documents reticulation/possible introgression alternatives.
supplement_recovery_status: Supplementary Table S1 was recovered and gives six var. takaoense transcriptome samples with vouchers/localities, but it does not identify which sample is white or bluish-purple.
EAzami_interpretation: Use the paper as evidence for same-variety colour polymorphism and competing introgression/parallel-mutation hypotheses. The published transcriptome tips cannot be converted to morph-specific tips without new voucher/author verification or new sampling.
